# Electromechanical Components Supplier and Custom Engineering Solutions

## Your partner for electromechanical components, distribution, and value-added engineering support.

You need a [electromechanical components][88] supplier and [custom engineering
solutions][89] provider that empowers you to the optimize cost and production time without
sacrificing performance or quality.

Since 1952, [Agility EMS][90] has gone above and beyond to help its customers innovate and find
creative solutions to their electromechanical challenges. Our customers value and expect our team’s
flexibility, speed, exceptional customer service, and ability to partner alongside them to quickly
deliver custom solutions.

Whether you require out-of-the-box components through our distribution services or a custom-built
assembly provided by our custom solutions and engineering services, you can consolidate your vendors
and streamline your fulfillment process, our Agility EMS team is here to serve you

[ CONTACT US ][91]
[ [Agility EMS] ][92]

## Our Shopping Cart Is Live!

Agility EMS is delighted to announce the launch of our brand-new shopping cart! After months of
dedication and hard work, we have successfully integrated a range of products with renowned brands
from 3M, Paktron, Mechanical Products, Trumeter, and Solico, making your shopping experience more
convenient than ever before. Visit our shopping cart today and discover the convenience of searching
our top-quality items!

[ [cart] ][93]

## Markets We Serve

We serve a variety of [markets][94] based on our customers’ requirements, including key industries
that drive the American economy. From mobility controls for farm machinery to sensing equipment for
hospital-grade instruments to assemblies that support IoT infrastructure, partner with Agility EMS
for high-quality electromechanical components and value-added engineering support.

## Trust Agility EMS

For the Agility EMS team, HEART is at the center of every client relationship. When you partner with
us, you can expect Honest communication, a commitment to innovation that empowers us to Evolve, and
an Accountable team that treats all stakeholders with Respect and uses Teamwork to find lasting
solutions. These values have helped Agility EMS serve thousands of customers since 1952.

* **Mechanical:** Tactile feedback, durable, better for typing
* **Membrane:** Quieter, more affordable, less tactile
* **Scissor-switch:** Low profile, good for laptops

#### Key Considerations:
* **Actuation force:** 45-60g is ideal for most typists
* **Key travel:** 3-4mm provides good feedback
* **Layout:** Full-size, TKL (Tenkeyless), or 60% based on needs
* **Connectivity:** Wired for gaming, wireless for office

## Typing Resources & Learning

### Typing History

The QWERTY layout was designed in 1873 to prevent typewriter jams. Modern keyboards retain this
layout despite the original need being obsolete.

**Fun Fact:** The world record typing speed is 216 WPM by Stella Pajunas in 1946!

### For Programmers
* Practice with code snippets
* Master special characters ({ } [ ] ; :)
* Learn keyboard shortcuts (Ctrl+C, Ctrl+V)
* Typing speed vs. thinking speed balance

### Accessibility
* Voice-to-text alternatives
* Ergonomic keyboard layouts
* Sticky keys and filter keys
* Adaptive typing software

[TypingClub][69] [Keybr][70] [Monkeytype][71] [Typing.com][72] [10FastFingers][73]

### Frequently Asked Questions

#### What is a good typing speed?

40-50 WPM is average, 65+ is good, 80+ is excellent. Professional typists often reach 90-120 WPM.

#### How long does it take to improve?

With daily practice, most people see significant improvement in 2-3 weeks. Mastery takes several
months.

#### Is accuracy more important than speed?

Initially yes. Build accuracy first, then gradually increase speed while maintaining high accuracy.

#### Should I learn touch typing?

Absolutely! Touch typing (using all fingers without looking) can double or triple your speed
compared to hunt-and-peck.

Type slowly and focus on 100% accuracy. Speed will naturally increase over time.

Start This Drill

#### Speed Burst Drill

3 minutes | Focus: Speed

Type as fast as possible for 30 seconds, rest 10 seconds, repeat.

Start This Drill

#### Numbers & Symbols Drill

7 minutes | Focus: Special Characters

Practice typing numbers (123...), symbols (!@#$%), and mixed alphanumeric text.

The right keyboard can significantly improve your typing speed and comfort. Here are our top

Best for: Gamers & Fast Typists

### Keyboard Buying Guide

#### Switch Types:
* **Mechanical:** Tactile feedback, durable, better for typing
* **Membrane:** Quieter, more affordable, less tactile
* **Scissor-switch:** Low profile, good for laptops

#### Key Considerations:
* **Actuation force:** 45-60g is ideal for most typists
* **Key travel:** 3-4mm provides good feedback
* **Layout:** Full-size, TKL (Tenkeyless), or 60% based on needs
* **Connectivity:** Wired for gaming, wireless for office

Regular practice leads to improvement. Track your WPM over time to see your growth.

## Typing Resources & Learning

### Typing History

The QWERTY layout was designed in 1873 to prevent typewriter jams. Modern keyboards retain this
layout despite the original need being obsolete.

**Fun Fact:** The world record typing speed is 216 WPM by Stella Pajunas in 1946!

### For Programmers
* Practice with code snippets
* Master special characters ({ } [ ] ; :)
* Learn keyboard shortcuts (Ctrl+C, Ctrl+V)
* Typing speed vs. thinking speed balance

### Accessibility
* Voice-to-text alternatives
* Ergonomic keyboard layouts
* Sticky keys and filter keys
* Adaptive typing software

[TypingClub][69] [Keybr][70] [Monkeytype][71] [Typing.com][72] [10FastFingers][73]

### Frequently Asked Questions

#### What is a good typing speed?

40-50 WPM is average, 65+ is good, 80+ is excellent. Professional typists often reach 90-120 WPM.

#### How long does it take to improve?

With daily practice, most people see significant improvement in 2-3 weeks. Mastery takes several
months.

#### Is accuracy more important than speed?

Initially yes. Build accuracy first, then gradually increase speed while maintaining high accuracy.

#### Should I learn touch typing?

Absolutely! Touch typing (using all fingers without looking) can double or triple your speed
compared to hunt-and-peck.

## Products & Services

Marubun/Arrow offers one of the most comprehensive electronics portfolios in the industry, backed by
engineering support and supply chain solutions tailored to your needs. Whether youre designing a new
product or managing procurement at scale, we provide access to top-tier technologies and world-class
service.

From design to distribution, we help bring next-generation technologies to life — faster, smarter,
and at scale.
* Semiconductors / Electronic Components
* Software
* Measurement / Display Equipment
* Inspection and Analysis Equipment
* ICT Solutions
* Assembly / Robotics
* Laser / Optical Parts
* And More...

## Markets We Serve

From the road to the operating room, Marubun/Arrow supports innovation across a wide range of
industries. Our broad supplier network, deep technical expertise, and global infrastructure allow us
to meet the complex needs of customers in highly specialized markets.

Automotive
[Automotive]

We support innovation in ADAS, electrification, and in-vehicle connectivity with cutting-edge
components and embedded systems designed for automotive-grade performance and reliability.

Industry
[Industry]

From factory automation to predictive maintenance, we power industrial transformation with robotics,
sensors, control systems, and custom-engineered solutions.

Medical Care
[Medical Care]

Precision, reliability, and compliance are paramount in medical applications. Our portfolio supports
diagnostic equipment, patient monitoring systems, and wearable devices.

Telecom
[Telecom]

Marubun/Arrow helps telecom leaders deploy next-gen infrastructure with components and systems that
support 5G networks, edge computing, and high-speed data transmission.

Space/Defense
[Space/Defense]

We provide mission-critical technologies and supply chain support for aerospace and defense
programs, helping customers meet rigorous standards for safety, performance, and traceability.

Healthcare
[Healthcare]

Beyond devices, we support digital health innovation with embedded solutions, imaging systems, and
secure data-handling technologies that drive better patient outcomes.

# Introducing Panel Mounts

With a custom panel mount assembly, you can plug connectors directly into device walls or
free-hanging connectors for efficient in-the-field assembly. Tell us about your project
specifications, and we’ll help engineer a custom solution.

## Intelligent Engineering, Innovative Manufacturing

MJM Industries is a world-class, custom contract manufacturing company that specializes in custom
overmolded cable and wire harness assemblies, coaxial cable assemblies, flat flex cable assemblies,
control panels, and electromechanical devices.

We are contract manufacturers committed to providing high-quality and reliable products that enable
our customers to realize greater productivity and profitability. From design services to custom
overmolding, cable assembly, packaging, and testing, we strive to provide a complete manufacturing
program for customers who demand reliable assemblies with on-time delivery.

For certain applications, MJM Industries offers Class III laser stripping for accurate and
repeatable removal of insulation and jacket material without the risk of conductor damage.
Additional value-added services include box and panel builds, OEM product integration, and custom
kitting and packaging.

As a leading cable assembly manufacturer, we have successfully assisted our customers with designing
processes and products to solve various problems in quality, delivery, and pricing. Our exceptional
team of in-house engineers can design products that bring ideas to reality.

MJM Industries is committed to the highest level of quality and continuous improvement of products
that offer the best value to meet our customers’ expectations. Our quality systems are
prevention-based, customer-focused and compliant with leading U.S. and international standards. MJM
Industries is also an ITAR-compliant contract manufacturer.

MJM Industries provides custom, overmolded components for cable and wire harnesses with value-added
services, delivered on time and at a competitive price. We look forward to beginning a dialogue to
understand your needs for our custom cable manufacturing services.

## Do you really know who you’re dealing with?

We enter into contracts with companies every day. Each of those contracts was with something with
legal personality – almost always a "legal entity". Yet too often we're ignorant of them and who is
behind them, with all the attendant risks that brings.

Whether you're in business, government, journalism, activism, research or a consumer — [our
goal][39] is to help you better understand the companies you deal with.

Search the world’s largest open legal-entity database or plug the data direct into your applications

## It shouldn't be hard to get legal-entity data you can trust

And yet it is. Legal-entity information is dispersed across hundreds of business registers that are
hard to navigate and impossible to access at scale. Traditional company-data aggregators are no
longer the answer either, given their opaque processes and provenance.

Verifiable accuracy is more important than ever, and you should expect more.

You need data built on deep expertise, rigorous data models and [well-founded, forward-looking
principles][43]. Data sourced direct from primary sources, curated with clear decision-making and no
hidden bias, and defined by open not proprietary identifiers and standards. Data you know you can
trust.

# Elektronik Komponent Tedariğinde Kurumsal Çözüm Ortağı – Robotistan Pro

Robotistan Pro, elektronik komponent ve robotik malzeme ihtiyaçlarını kurumsal satın alma
süreçlerine uygun şekilde karşılamak üzere yapılandırılmış B2B odaklı bir tedarik platformudur. LCSC
Türkiye distribütörlüğü kapsamında 1.000.000’dan fazla elektronik komponent ve 3.000’den fazla
markaya erişim sağlayan Robotistan Pro, üretim, Ar-Ge, mühendislik ve satın alma ekipleri için
güvenilir bir elektronik komponent tedarikçisi olmayı hedefler.

Elektronik komponent satış süreçlerinde ürün listelemenin yanında; fiyat/stok bilgisi, proforma
talebi, proje bazlı talep formu, ürün kodu ile sorgulama, katalog dışı ürün araştırması ve kurumsal
tedarik ihtiyaçları için destek sunar. Böylece firmalar, elektronik komponent tedariği sürecinde
ihtiyaç duydukları ürünlere daha planlı, şeffaf ve yönetilebilir bir yapı üzerinden ulaşabilir.

## LCSC İşbirliği ile 1 Milyondan Fazla Elektronik Parça

Dünyanın önde gelen komponent distribütörlerinden LCSC ile kurduğumuz stratejik işbirliği sayesinde,
Asya pazarının devasa stok gücünü Türkiye'ye taşıyoruz. İhtiyaç duyduğunuz her türlü **elektronik
parça** için **LCSC Türkiye** iş ortağı olarak 3000'den fazla markanın 1.000.000'u aşkın orijinal
ürününü tek tıkla erişilebilir kılıyoruz. Türkiye'deki **elektronik komponent firmaları** arasında
sunduğumuz emsalsiz ürün derinliği, üretim hatlarınızın hiçbir zaman durmamasını sağlar.

## Gelişmiş Proje Bazlı Toptan Malzeme Tedariği

Standart bir alışveriş deneyiminin ötesine geçen Robotistan Pro, kurumsal firmaların satın alma
süreçlerini optimize etmek için tasarlanmıştır. Gelişmiş e-ticaret altyapımızda yer alan BOM
(Malzeme Listesi) aracı ile binlerce kalemden oluşan özel listelerinizi saniyeler içinde
fiyatlandırabilirsiniz. İster prototipleme için tek bir ürün, ister büyük ölçekli projeleriniz için
yüksek hacimli **toptan malzeme** alımı yapın; özel müşteri temsilcilerimiz sürecin her aşamasında
yanınızdadır.

## Gümrük ve Lojistik Derdi Olmadan Güvenilir Komponent Tedariği

Küresel pazardan donanım tedarik etmenin en büyük zorluğu olan bürokrasi, gümrük ve nakliye
operasyonlarını sizin yerinize tamamen biz üstleniyoruz. Güçlü bir **komponent tedarikçisi** olarak
tüm ürünleri vergiler ve kargo dahil şeffaf fiyatlarla sunuyor; sürpriz maliyetleri ortadan
kaldırıyoruz. Hızlı teslimat ağımız ve profesyonel tedarik zinciri yönetimimizle işletmenize sadece
üretime odaklanma özgürlüğü sunuyoruz.

## Neden Robotistan Pro?
* 1.000.000’dan fazla elektronik komponent seçeneği
* 3.000’den fazla markaya erişim imkânı
* LCSC Türkiye distribütörlüğü ile güçlü global tedarik ağı
* Kurumsal satın alma ekipleri için fiyat, stok ve proforma süreçleri
* Gümrük, yurtdışı kargo ve KDV dahil fiyatlandırma yaklaşımı
* Üretim, Ar-Ge, IoT, otomasyon, robotik ve elektronik projeler için tedarik desteği
* Robotistan güvencesiyle kurumsal elektronik komponent alışverişi

## Elektronik Komponent Online Satış ve Tedarik Platformu

Robotistan Pro üzerinden elektronik komponent satın alma, fiyat/stok bilgisi alma, proforma talep
etme veya proje bazlı tedarik süreci başlatma işlemleri tek platform üzerinden yönetilebilir. Geniş
ürün yelpazesi, LCSC destekli marka ağı ve kurumsal talep süreçleriyle Robotistan Pro, Türkiye’de
elektronik komponent tedariği için profesyonel bir çözüm noktası sunar.

# Elektronik Komponent Tedariğinde Kurumsal Çözüm Ortağı – Robotistan Pro

Robotistan Pro, elektronik komponent ve robotik malzeme ihtiyaçlarını kurumsal satın alma
süreçlerine uygun şekilde karşılamak üzere yapılandırılmış B2B odaklı bir tedarik platformudur. LCSC
Türkiye distribütörlüğü kapsamında 1.000.000’dan fazla elektronik komponent ve 3.000’den fazla
markaya erişim sağlayan Robotistan Pro, üretim, Ar-Ge, mühendislik ve satın alma ekipleri için
güvenilir bir elektronik komponent tedarikçisi olmayı hedefler.

Elektronik komponent satış süreçlerinde ürün listelemenin yanında; fiyat/stok bilgisi, proforma
talebi, proje bazlı talep formu, ürün kodu ile sorgulama, katalog dışı ürün araştırması ve kurumsal
tedarik ihtiyaçları için destek sunar. Böylece firmalar, elektronik komponent tedariği sürecinde
ihtiyaç duydukları ürünlere daha planlı, şeffaf ve yönetilebilir bir yapı üzerinden ulaşabilir.

## LCSC İşbirliği ile 1 Milyondan Fazla Elektronik Parça

Dünyanın önde gelen komponent distribütörlerinden LCSC ile kurduğumuz stratejik işbirliği sayesinde,
Asya pazarının devasa stok gücünü Türkiye'ye taşıyoruz. İhtiyaç duyduğunuz her türlü **elektronik
parça** için **LCSC Türkiye** iş ortağı olarak 3000'den fazla markanın 1.000.000'u aşkın orijinal
ürününü tek tıkla erişilebilir kılıyoruz. Türkiye'deki **elektronik komponent firmaları** arasında
sunduğumuz emsalsiz ürün derinliği, üretim hatlarınızın hiçbir zaman durmamasını sağlar.

## Gelişmiş Proje Bazlı Toptan Malzeme Tedariği

Standart bir alışveriş deneyiminin ötesine geçen Robotistan Pro, kurumsal firmaların satın alma
süreçlerini optimize etmek için tasarlanmıştır. Gelişmiş e-ticaret altyapımızda yer alan BOM
(Malzeme Listesi) aracı ile binlerce kalemden oluşan özel listelerinizi saniyeler içinde
fiyatlandırabilirsiniz. İster prototipleme için tek bir ürün, ister büyük ölçekli projeleriniz için
yüksek hacimli **toptan malzeme** alımı yapın; özel müşteri temsilcilerimiz sürecin her aşamasında
yanınızdadır.

## Gümrük ve Lojistik Derdi Olmadan Güvenilir Komponent Tedariği

Küresel pazardan donanım tedarik etmenin en büyük zorluğu olan bürokrasi, gümrük ve nakliye
operasyonlarını sizin yerinize tamamen biz üstleniyoruz. Güçlü bir **komponent tedarikçisi** olarak
tüm ürünleri vergiler ve kargo dahil şeffaf fiyatlarla sunuyor; sürpriz maliyetleri ortadan
kaldırıyoruz. Hızlı teslimat ağımız ve profesyonel tedarik zinciri yönetimimizle işletmenize sadece
üretime odaklanma özgürlüğü sunuyoruz.

## Neden Robotistan Pro?
* 1.000.000’dan fazla elektronik komponent seçeneği
* 3.000’den fazla markaya erişim imkânı
* LCSC Türkiye distribütörlüğü ile güçlü global tedarik ağı
* Kurumsal satın alma ekipleri için fiyat, stok ve proforma süreçleri
* Gümrük, yurtdışı kargo ve KDV dahil fiyatlandırma yaklaşımı
* Üretim, Ar-Ge, IoT, otomasyon, robotik ve elektronik projeler için tedarik desteği
* Robotistan güvencesiyle kurumsal elektronik komponent alışverişi

## Elektronik Komponent Online Satış ve Tedarik Platformu

Robotistan Pro üzerinden elektronik komponent satın alma, fiyat/stok bilgisi alma, proforma talep
etme veya proje bazlı tedarik süreci başlatma işlemleri tek platform üzerinden yönetilebilir. Geniş
ürün yelpazesi, LCSC destekli marka ağı ve kurumsal talep süreçleriyle Robotistan Pro, Türkiye’de

* Capital Badge: Innovation and Technology Partner
* Dualis Label: Top Conditions for All
* Prädikat: Family-conscious company
* Kununu Score: Employer rating Würth Elektronik

For the seventh time in a row, the Würth Elektronik Group has been recognized as one of the "Most
Innovative Companies in Germany" in the innovation ranking by Statista and the renowned business
magazine Capital.

The overall result with four out of five possible stars in the category "Electronics & Electrical
Engineering, Automation & Metrology" confirms that Würth Elektronik is valued in the market as an
innovative promoter and enabler of advanced technologies.

We are delighted to receive this award and see it as an incentive to continue working with our
customers and partners to make innovations possible, drive technology forward and promote
sustainability.

Training and the promotion of young talents are particularly important at Würth Elektronik. However,
we do not limit the quality of our training to the mere teaching of content. It starts from the very
first contact between us and the future trainees and extends throughout the entire training period
thanks to individual support at eye level. Intensive support during the examination phase and early
interviews with our trained instructors are also a matter of course for us.

In June 2025, the Heilbronn-Franken Chamber of Industry and Commerce reviewed these and many other
aspects of our training work once again and, following a comprehensive audit, awarded us the Dualis
seal as an excellent training company for a further five years.

[ Start apprenticeship or study now! ][51]

We are proud that Würth Elektronik eiSos was able to impress with its "above-average commitment"
directly in the first audit, both as a "family-conscious company" and in the "Excellent Digital"
category. 
From advice for parents-to-be, childcare options and flexible return-to-work options to
advice/support for caring for relatives: Our employees can rely on us to provide them with the right
support in challenging situations. 
The "Excellent Digital" award explicitly confirms our success in the continuous expansion of a
digital working and learning environment. Mobile working, hybrid meetings, digital health programs
and online training opportunities are now an integral part of our work culture.

### FFC Cable Robotics & Automation – High-Flex, Multi-Axis Cabling

Robotics require high-cycle, bend-resistant cables for arms, joints, and control systems.

Robotic arms and automated platforms demand cables that can flex thousands of times without
degradation. We address failure from fatigue and EMI that causes positional errors by engineering
FFCs with proven flex‐life testing and robust shielding solutions.
* Flexible FFC cables endure over 20000 flex cycles in robotic joints for uptime.

* High-temperature FFC withstands 130°C for robot arm operation in environments.

cables to ultrasound, imaging, and wearable device manufacturers with full traceability.

### FFC Cable for Smart Home Devices – Thin & Compact Connectivity

Smart home devices demand space-efficient, low-profile interconnects for displays, sensors, and
embedded systems.

Smart home devices demand discreet, thin‐profile cabling behind walls or inside slim modules. We
solve clutter and EM interference issues so sensors, controllers, and touchpanels remain reliable
over Wi-Fi and Zigbee networks without bulky harnesses or signal dropout.
* Slim FFC cables integrate behind walls enabling discreet sensor control wiring.
* Noise-free twisted pair FFC reduce EMI interference for stable home use reliably

understand key pain points—cable fatigue and signal noise—by supplying automotive-grade FFCs that
resist wide temperature ranges, block EMI from engine electronics, and extend harness life.
* Automotive FFC rated -40°C to 125°C resists vibration for car harness operation.

temperature resistance (up to 125°C), and multi-core signal/power lines in one compact form. Used in
over 100 ESS projects globally.

smartphones, smartwatches, earbuds, and wearables.
